sentences.en: What number should I call in case of an emergency?
sentences.zh: 遇到紧急情况我该拨打什么电话？

sentences.en: Please push this button at once in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 一旦发生紧急情况，请立即按下这个按钮。

sentences.en: In an emergency you can fall back on your savings.
sentences.zh: 在紧急情况下，你可以动用你的储蓄。

senses.zh: 紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻
